**Finding submitted: INDEMN — missing (critical), confidence 0.9.**

- **Investigation:** No indemnity language exists anywhere — searches for "indemnify / hold harmless / defend" and for infringement remedies (procure/modify/replace/refund) returned nothing operative, and the outline jumps from Section 19 (Warranties) to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability). Sections 9.3 ("remedies required by Section 20.5"), 19.4, 19.5, 21.3, 29.2 and 30.5 all assume indemnification obligations and indemnified parties the document never creates.
- **Level chosen:** preferred. The fallback's 3× annual-fees super-cap would be worse for us than the existing Section 21.3, which already treats indemnification obligations as uncapped Excluded Claims, so we did not import that cap or the fallback-only remedy ladder.
- **Cure:** one insert_after §19.5 creating Section 20.1 — Vendor defence/indemnity for Services and Deliverables IP infringement, Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access to Customer Data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; notice, control of defence, reasonable cooperation; and a limit confirming any Customer indemnity reaches only Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law (drafted as a ceiling so it creates no new Customer obligation). Redline validated ok:true on anchors and the minimality gate.
